intro: MIST Hyderabad and Sphoorthy Engineering College both sit in Hyderabad, and this page compares their recorded Polytechnic Course fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

MIST Hyderabad vs Sphoorthy Engineering College is not a single winner. Both are recorded as private institutes. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: MIST Hyderabad vs Sphoorthy Engineering College for Polytechnic Course: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose MIST Hyderabad if its Polytechnic Course programme, location and recorded outcomes match the kind of work or further study you want.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹15,200 a year as tuition fees for MIST Hyderabad's Polytechnic Course Mechanical Engineering. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.

Our records list ₹15,500 a year as tuition fees for Sphoorthy Engineering College's Polytechnic Course Civil Engineering. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, MIST Hyderabad's 2023 figures are an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹14 lakh for Polytechnic Course Mechanical Engineering. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.

In our records, Sphoorthy Engineering College's 2023 figures are an average of ₹3 lakh and a highest of ₹8 lakh for Polytechnic Course Civil Engineering. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

paragraphs: Both campuses are in Hyderabad, Telangana. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
